# Laurel Way Partners

> Laurel Way Partners is an attorney-led platform that partners with elder law, estate planning and probate firms in the New York metro area and northern New Jersey.

Laurel Way Partners works with owner-operators of elder law, estate planning, and probate and trust administration firms on Long Island, in Westchester, in the five boroughs and in northern New Jersey, typically with roughly $750K–$3M in revenue and one to five attorneys. Owners choose one of two paths: partner and keep practicing (sell a minority stake to an attorney licensed in the firm's state for liquidity, keep running the practice, have a services team handle marketing, intake, administration and technology under the firm's direction, and hold equity in the platform), or retire on their own timeline (a purchase by an attorney licensed in the owner's state, structured under the professional rules on the sale of a law practice, staff kept, a structured handoff). Firms stay owned by attorneys; Laurel Way Partners holds no stake in any law firm. Conversations are confidential and covered by an NDA before any details are shared. Laurel Way Partners LLC is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. The firms we work with are independently owned and operated by licensed attorneys. Contact: hello@laurelwaypartners.com
